versions.changelog:
Initial release of the site-architecture skill.

- Helps plan website page hierarchy, navigation, URL structure, and internal linking.
- Covers key concepts: site types, typical depth, navigation design, and URL patterns.
- Includes detailed design principles for hierarchy (3-click rule, flat vs deep, ASCII tree examples).
- Offers navigation and breadcrumb conventions, footer organization, and common URL structure mistakes.
- Clarifies when to use this skill versus seo-audit or schema tasks.
